card.name: Cooking instructions in recipes
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside recipe steps and food writing, especially cooking temperatures, heat and timing directions, and ingredient lists. Often the period or number in a step such as cooking chicken to 165 degrees.

modes.label: Cooking step punctuation and numbers
modes.description: Periods, spaces and digits inside skillet cooking steps with temperatures.
modes.example: cook chicken in oil over medium heat for five to six minutes on each side or until meat thermometer reaches a temperature of 165 degrees<<.>> Remove and keep warm.

modes.label: Ingredient and food prose
modes.description: Linking words in recipe ingredient notes or food descriptions.
modes.example: Use a good-quality medium-bodied wine, such<< as>> a Cotes du Rhone or pin

card.writes: It pushes down chef and restaurant words, so cooking text is less likely to continue into chef or cuisine terms.
card.plain: It lights up on recipe instructions like cooking chicken to a set temperature.
